metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace: audit, explore and propose skills for conventional and LLM/agentic applications.

plugins.name: audit-core
plugins.description: Shared audit contract every audit plugin depends on: finding schema and severity rubric (findings.py), cross-skill rollup and go/no-go verdict, stack detection, repo walker and grep runner, sensitive-data catalog, git-history helper, endpoint inventory, OWASP/ASVS mapper and the final report generator.

plugins.name: audit-app
plugins.description: Pre-production audit of a conventional web/service application: the audit-application orchestrator plus 30 topic audits covering security, correctness, performance, frontend, readiness and compliance.

plugins.name: audit-llm
plugins.description: Explore, audit and propose phases for LLM/agentic applications: prompt injection, jailbreaks, guardrails, excessive agency, resource limits, data isolation, supply chain, output quality, evals and observability, with the shared LLM building blocks (stack detection, payloads, probe runner, trust classification).

plugins.name: explore-app
plugins.description: Read-only documentation of a conventional application (architecture, schema, Business-Logic Document) and proposals cross-checked against it (architecture changes, schema changes, missing use cases). No audit-core dependency.
